verdict.rationale: The project-local half is well evidenced. `ultrametric init` writes skill files into the project's `.agents/skills` and `.claude/skills` (confirmed by a hands-on `--path` dry run), and the docs say to commit them to share the setup with the team. The only global evidence is `npm install -g` for the CLI binary itself. Nothing shows a choice to install the skills or plugin user-globally across all projects. Missing for 10: a documented user-global scope option for skill/plugin install (e.g., a home-directory target or a scope flag), and docs explaining how to choose between project and global scope.
